label: usmile-filtered-deck-complete
context:
UWorld Pipeline COMPLETE. 396 cloze Anki cards created in deck "UWorld Weak Subtopics" from 186 UWorld quizzes, filtered to Danny's 38 weakest Step 1 subtopics. Combined with Phase 1 (4,077 NBME cards), Danny now has ~4,473 targeted Anki cards for Step 1 prep (~May 7).

Key technical breakthrough: The POST body for getTestByQuestionIndexes requires PascalCase fields with STRING TestRecordId: {"TestRecordId": "421548864", "QbankId": 1, "QuestionIndexes": [1507, ...]}. Also, correctAnswer is a STRING while choiceNumber is an INT, requiring int() conversion.

The pipeline is split into Phase 1 (uworld_phase1.py — scans 186 tests, saves matches) and Phase 2 (uworld_phase2.py — fetches full content, creates Anki cards). Both require Chrome CDP on port 9222 for auth extraction and API calls via fetch() to avoid CORS.
next_steps: Inform Danny that the UWorld pipeline is complete with 396 cards. Ask if he wants to verify the cards in Anki or needs anything else for Step 1 prep.
